job.title: Siding demo, reinstall, and color-match paint
scopeNotes: Demo is ONE lump: existing siding (450 sq ft), chimney chase (~25 ft height), and all 13 window/door trims. Not split per surface.
The $1,000 demo figure is hard cost only. Standard profit margin is applied on top — not a pass-through.
Dump/disposal is a separate hauling fee, not part of the $1,000 demo labor.
Photo survey 2026-09-09: chimney is a siding-clad chase with gray corner boards. Takeoff remains 25 ft × 8 ft assumed wrap = 200 sq ft (bump-out sides + above-roof stack).
Window trim wood is 24 sticks of 10 lf for the 13 openings. Hard cost $160, then 20% material markup and 30% profit — not a pass-through.
The 13 trim units include mixed openings seen on site (small hoppers, sliders, half-round transom, patio slider). Same labor unit rate; arch and door are the hard ones, small uppers are faster.
Color match: siding to existing cream/off-white field paint; trim to existing gray. Both are field-painted, not a factory color.
Reinstall and paint on the house wall are 450 sq ft. Chimney reinstall is the 200 sq ft wrap at the height-premium labor rate, including corner boards.
Does not include dry-rot/sheathing repair, housewrap, flashing upgrades, scaffolding rental as a separate line, permits, or lead testing.

findings: Two-story cream / pale-yellow horizontal lap (wood-grain), gray window and corner trim — matches prior SmartSide-style ID.

Chimney is a siding-clad chase / bump-out, not brick: stacked windows on the front, a side-face window, gray corner boards running grade-to-cap, stack continuing above the ridge (~25 ft height confirmed).

13 openings on the surveyed walls include mixed sizes: small uppers, sliders, one half-round transom, and a patio sliding door. All existing gray trim is weathered; several pieces are peeling (especially the horizontal slider).
Siding has open butt joints and hairline cracks at window corners — supports full demo/reinstall, not paint-only.
Fixtures to pull and reset: wall lights, camera, junction/electrical covers (counted as 5).
A painted 16-ft leftover lap board is on site (sample / spare). Not credited against material.
Tree limbs close to the wall; 2-story ladder/scaffold access required for the chase.
